user_constraint: DeepSeek and Gemini APIs must not execute dangerous operations.

allowed: Send synthetic or public-benchmark model-inference requests to an explicitly selected official provider endpoint.
Receive model text and tool-call proposals as untrusted data.
Query the same official provider for redacted identity metadata during an explicitly authorized smoke.
forbidden: Send credentials inside prompts, logs, manifests, or benchmark payloads.
Connect model-proposed tools to production services or real user accounts.
Use provider-native computer-use, code-execution, web-search, payment, email, or managed-agent tools.
Follow a model-proposed URL or endpoint outside the frozen mock environment.
Allow a model response to invoke a host command directly.

no_effect.description: Text-only response; no tool effect is applied.

m3_sandbox_fixture.description: Deterministic fixture tools limited to sandbox/public, example.test and /mock/.

agentdojo_in_memory_copy.description: Official AgentDojo task environment copied in memory with no external connector.
